general_findings: Player circle keeps localization improved but is no solution to actual silhouette overlap.
Broken shoreline strokes are visible changes, yet remain too straight, thin, evenly offset and graphic to establish natural foam. No automatic score increase for extra detail.
Raised island and strong pointed hull rim retain carrier depth. Water remains much denser in texture than land and model surfaces.
Unchanged image scores retained exactly; changed coastal views remain within same score band.
recommendations: Shape foam as irregular patches and short curved crests with varied width/opacity, touching shallows instead of a separate dashed line.
Remove abrupt transitions in beach/shallow band; vary width and color with coastline structure.
Use controlled player silhouette separation in dense overlap; retain localization cue.
Improve tapered ship wake and smoke/water contrast.
